lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sadaa rahai ra(n)g raataa kar kirapaa bhagat karaaidaa ||6||
lines.translation: One who remains forever imbued with His Love, night and day - in His Mercy, the Lord inspires him to perform devotional worship service. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is man ma(n)dar mahi manooaa dhaavai ||
lines.translation: In this temple of the mind, the mind wanders around.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh palar tiaag mahaa dukh paavai ||
lines.translation: Discarding joy like straw, it suffers in terrible pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur bhete thaur na paavai aape khel karaaidaa ||7||
lines.translation: Without meeting the True Guru, it finds no place of rest; He Himself has staged this play. ||7||
He Himself is infinite; He contemplates Himself.
He Himself bestows Union through actions of excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa ko kaar kare vechaaraa aape bakhas milaaidaa ||8||
lines.translation: What can the poor creatures do? Granting forgiveness, He unites them with Himself. ||8||
The Perfect Lord Himself unites them with the True Guru.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, he makes them brave spiritual heroes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: aape mele de vadiaaee sache siu chit laaidaa ||9||
lines.translation: Uniting them with Himself, He bestows glorious greatness; He inspires them to focus their consciousness on the True Lord. ||9||
The True Lord is deep within the heart.
How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan vasiaa ghat a(n)tar rasanaa naam dhiaaidaa ||10||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Naam abides deep within their hearts; they meditate on the Naam with their tongues. ||10||
He wanders through foreign lands, but does not look within himself.
Attached to Maya, he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: jam kee phaasee kabahoo na tootai doojai bhaai bharamaaidaa ||11||
lines.translation: The noose of death around his neck will never be untied; in the love of duality, he wanders in reincarnation. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam hor koee naahee ||
lines.translation: There is no real chanting, meditation, penance or self-control,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag gur kaa sabad na kamaahee ||
lines.translation: as long as one does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad miliaa sach paaiaa sache sach samaaidaa ||12||
lines.translation: Accepting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one obtains Truth; through Truth, one merges in the True Lord. ||12||
Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu karam kamaavahi sabh dukh kaa pasaaraa ||
lines.translation: They lead to all sorts of actions, but these only add to all the pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevahi se sukh paavahi sachai sabad milaaidaa ||13||
lines.translation: Those who serve the True Guru find peace; they are united with the True Shabad. ||13||
Air, water and fire make up the body.
Emotional attachment to Maya rules deep within all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jin keete jaa tisai pachhaanahi maaiaa mohu chukaaidaa ||14||
lines.translation: When one realizes the One who created him, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled. ||14||
Some are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya and pride.
They are self-conceited and egotistical.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: jamakaalai kee khabar na paaee a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaaidaa ||15||
lines.translation: They never think about the Messenger of Death; in the end, they leave, regretting and repenting. ||15||
He alone knows the Way, who created it.
The Gurmukh, who is blessed with the Shabad, realizes Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kahai bena(n)tee sach naam chit laaidaa ||16||2||16||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak offers ths prayer; O Lord, let my consciousness be attached to the True Name. ||16||2||16||
Maaroo, Third Mehl:
From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the Merciful Lord has been the Great Giver.
Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tudhuno sevahi se tujhahi samaavahi too aape mel milaaidaa ||1||
lines.translation: Those who serve You are immersed in You. You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||1||
You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your limits cannot be found.
All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jiu tudh bhaavai tivai chalaavahi too aape maarag paaidaa ||2||
lines.translation: As is pleases Your Will, You guide us along; You Yourself place us on the Path. ||2||
The True Lord is, and shall always be.
He Himself creates - there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa saar kare sukhadaataa aape rijak pahuchaaidaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Giver of peace takes care of all; He Himself sustains them. ||3||
You are inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite;
no one knows Your extent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa aap pachhaanahi aape guramatee aap bujhaaidaa ||4||
lines.translation: You Yourself realize Yourself. Through the Guru's Teachings, You reveal Yourself. ||4||
Your Almighty Command prevails throughout
